description: This Java class 'ScaleImage' provides methods to scale product images into multiple predefined sizes (small, medium, large, detail). It reads configuration from XML, processes images, saves scaled versions, and generates URLs for these images within an OFBiz-based e-commerce system.

classes.name: ScaleImage
classes.description: A utility class for scaling product images into multiple sizes, reading configuration from XML, and managing image files and URLs within an OFBiz environment.

methods.name: scaleImageInAllSize
methods.description: Scales the original image into small, medium, large, and detail sizes, saves the scaled images, and returns their URLs along with the original image.

methods.name: scaleImageManageInAllSize
methods.description: Similar to scaleImageInAllSize but allows specifying specific image types and handles additional view types.

methods.name: scaleImageManageInAllSize
methods.description: Overloaded method with additional parameters for managing multiple image sizes and view types.
